name: round4_scanner_aug
description: Same recipe as round3_cv_final_epoch (80 epochs, final-epoch weights, seed 3710) with the 'scanner' augmentation profile (bias field, noise, blur/sharpen, wider gain/gamma). Folds 4 and 5 are used because their validation sets hold the most AD scans acquired 2017-2019 (24 and 26), the group affected by the acquisition confound; the folds were chosen by this count, not by model scores. Primary outcome: scan AUROC on validation scans acquired 2017-2019.
